## Figure 5B
```{r message = F, results = F, warning = F, fig.width = 14, fig.height = 6, fig_5B}
DC_palette <- c("DC1" = '#4B3F72', "DC2" = '#00916E', "DC: PIGR, RORC" = '#FFC857', "CD14" = "#36565C")

CFSE_data <- read.csv("/projects/home/tlchan/projects/ascites/second_data_freeze/data/metadata/combined_CFSE_stats.csv") %>%
    mutate(cell_category = gsub("newDC", "DC: PIGR, RORC", cell_category)) %>%
    mutate(cell_category = factor(cell_category, levels = c("CD14", "DC: PIGR, RORC", "DC1", "DC2")))

stats <- CFSE_data %>%
    filter(cell_category %in% c('DC: PIGR, RORC', 'CD14')) %>%
    t_test(log_CFSE_neg_perc ~ cell_category, paired = TRUE) %>%
    add_significance() %>%
    add_xy_position(x = "cell_category")

ggplot(CFSE_data, aes(x = factor(cell_category), y = log_CFSE_neg_perc)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, aes(fill = cell_category)) +
    geom_point(pch = 20, size = 2) +
    xlab("Cell category") +
    ylab("log(CFSE- percentage)") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = DC_palette) +
    stat_pvalue_manual(stats, label = "p = {p}", size = 5) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")
ggsave("/projects/home/tlchan/fig_panels/fig_5b.pdf", width = 4, height = 8)
```

## Figure 5D
```{r message = F, results = F, warning = F, fig.width = 14, fig.height = 6, fig_5D}
venn_genes <- read.csv("/projects/home/tlchan/projects/ascites/second_data_freeze/data/mlr_venn_genes.csv")

up_genes <- venn_genes %>%
    filter(var %in% c("newDC_up", "DC1_up")) %>%
    mutate(var = gsub("newDC_up", "DC: PIGR, RORC", var)) %>%
    mutate(var = gsub("DC1_up", "DC1", var)) %>%
    group_by(var) %>%
    summarise(values = list(gene), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    deframe()

down_genes <- venn_genes %>%
    filter(var %in% c("newDC_down", "DC1_down")) %>%
    mutate(var = gsub("newDC_down", "DC: PIGR, RORC", var)) %>%
    mutate(var = gsub("DC1_down", "DC1", var)) %>%
    group_by(var) %>%
    summarise(values = list(gene), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    deframe()

up_vd <- venn.diagram(x = up_genes,
                      fill = c("#4B3F72", "#FFC857"),
                      alpha = 0.80,
                      lty = c(1, 2),
                      ext.text = FALSE,
                      cex = 2,
                      fontfamily = "sans",
                      cat.fontfamily = "sans",
                      cat.cex = 2,
                      filename = NULL,
                      disable.logging = TRUE)
down_vd <- venn.diagram(x = down_genes,
                        fill = c("#4B3F72", "#FFC857"),
                        alpha = 0.80,
                        lty = c(1, 2),
                        ext.text = FALSE,
                        cex = 2,
                        fontfamily = "sans",
                        cat.fontfamily = "sans",
                        cat.cex = 2,
                        filename = NULL,
                        disable.logging = TRUE)

pdf("/projects/home/tlchan/fig_panels/fig_5d.pdf", width = 10, height = 10)
plot_grid(up_vd)
plot_grid(down_vd)
dev.off()
```

## Figure 5E
```{r message = F, results = F, warning = F, fig.width = 14, fig.height = 6, fig_5E}
setwd('/projects/home/tlchan/projects/ascites/second_data_freeze/data/mlr_degs/lineage_level')

lineage_list <- list(
    "combo_mlr" = "ALL",
    "combo_mlr_cd4" = "CD4",
    "combo_mlr_cd8" = "CD8"
)

# PREPARE DATA
all_res <- data.frame(baseMean = numeric(), log2FoldChange = numeric(), lfcSE = numeric(), stat = numeric(), pvalue = numeric(), padj = numeric(), gene_symbol = character(), lineage = character(), CFSE = character())

for (lin in names(lineage_list)) {
    for (cfse in c("CFSE_neg", "CFSE_pos")) {
        res <- read.csv(glue('{lin}_newDCvDC2_paired/{lin}_newDCvDC2_paired_{cfse}_de_by_newDCvDC2_paired_all_results.csv'))
        res$lineage <- lineage_list[lin]
        res$CFSE <- cfse

        all_res <- rbind(all_res, res)
    }
}

gene_markers <- read.csv('/projects/home/tlchan/projects/ascites/second_data_freeze/data/mlr_degs/mlr_plot_gene_markers.csv')
heatmap_genes <- gene_markers$heatmap_genes

# MAKE HEATMAP
lfc_mtx <- all_res %>%
    mutate(group = paste(lineage, CFSE, sep = "_")) %>%
    filter(gene_symbol %in% heatmap_genes) %>%
    select(log2FoldChange, gene_symbol, group) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = log2FoldChange) %>%
    column_to_rownames("gene_symbol") %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~replace_na(., 0))) %>%
    as.matrix()

# Cluster rows
row_clustering <- hclust(dist(lfc_mtx, method = "euclidean"), method = "ward.D2")
row_hc <- as.dendrogram(row_clustering)

# Heatmap color
heatmap_col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(min(lfc_mtx), 0, max(lfc_mtx)), c("green", "black", "yellow"))

# Label genes
highlight_genes <- gene_markers %>%
    filter(highlight == TRUE) %>%
    pull(heatmap_genes)

# Survival genes
bold_lineage_genes <- read.csv("/projects/home/tlchan/external_lineage_deg_gsea.csv", row.names = 1) %>%
    filter(lineage == "cd4") %>%
    filter(tissue_type == "ascites") %>%
    filter(var == "survival") %>%
    filter(pathway == "up_newDC_vs_DC2") %>%
    pull(leadingEdge) %>%
    strsplit(split = ",") %>%
    unlist()

bold_cluster_genes <- read.csv("/projects/home/tlchan/external_cluster_deg_gsea.csv", row.names = 1) %>%
    filter(lineage == "cd4") %>%
    filter(tissue_type == "ascites") %>%
    filter(var == "survival") %>%
    filter(pathway == "up_newDC_vs_DC2") %>%
    filter(padj < 0.1) %>%
    pull(leadingEdge) %>%
    strsplit(split = ",") %>%
    unlist()

# Get the gene colors
gene_weights <- c()
for (gene in highlight_genes) {
    weight <- ifelse(gene %in% c(bold_lineage_genes, bold_cluster_genes), "bold", "plain")
    gene_weights <- c(gene_weights, weight)
}

gene_annot <- rowAnnotation(link = anno_mark(at = match(highlight_genes, rownames(lfc_mtx)),
                                             labels = highlight_genes,
                                             labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = gene_weights)))

# Split CFSE
lfc_mtx <- lfc_mtx[, c("ALL_CFSE_pos", "CD8_CFSE_pos", "CD4_CFSE_pos", "ALL_CFSE_neg", "CD8_CFSE_neg", "CD4_CFSE_neg")]
sample_splits <- c(rep(c("CFSE+"), 3), rep(c("CFSE-"), 3))
colnames(lfc_mtx) <- rep(c("ALL", "CD8", "CD4"), 2)

# Split genes
gene_splits <- cutree(row_clustering, 2) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    `colnames<-`(c("Direction"))
gene_splits <- gene_splits %>% mutate(Direction = ifelse(Direction == 1, "Up in DC2", "Up in DC: PIGR, RORC"))
gene_splits$Direction <- factor(gene_splits$Direction)


# Plot heatmap
hmap <- Heatmap(lfc_mtx,
                name = "log2FC",
                col = heatmap_col_fun,
                show_column_names = TRUE,
                show_row_names = FALSE,
                cluster_rows = row_hc,
                clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
                clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
                cluster_columns = FALSE,
                show_heatmap_legend = TRUE,
                column_split = sample_splits,
                column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 14),
                column_names_side = "bottom",
                column_names_rot = 90,
                column_names_centered = TRUE,
                right_annotation = gene_annot)
pdf("/projects/home/tlchan/fig_panels/fig_5e.pdf", width = 3.5, height = 12)
print(hmap)
dev.off()
```

## Figure 5F
```{r message = F, results = F, warning = F, fig.width = 14, fig.height = 6, fig_5F}
gene_markers <- read.csv('/projects/home/tlchan/projects/ascites/second_data_freeze/data/mlr_degs/mlr_plot_gene_markers.csv')
up_newDC_vs_DC2_genes <- Filter(nzchar, gene_markers$up_dcnew_v_dc2)

# CD4 lineage, ascites, survival
cd4_lineage_fgsea_res <- read.csv("/projects/home/tlchan/external_lineage_deg_gsea.csv", row.names = 1) %>%
    filter(lineage == "cd4") %>%
    filter(tissue_type == "ascites") %>%
    filter(var == "survival") %>%
    filter(pathway == "up_newDC_vs_DC2")

cd4_lineage_stats <- read.csv("/projects/home/tlchan/projects/ascites/second_data_freeze/data/degs/lineage_level/survival/cd4_ascites_de_by_survival_all_results.csv") %>%
    arrange(desc(log2FoldChange)) %>%
    select(gene_symbol, log2FoldChange)
cd4_lineage_ranks <- setNames(cd4_lineage_stats$log2FoldChange, cd4_lineage_stats$gene_symbol)

cd4_lineage_p <- plot_fgsea(cd4_lineage_fgsea_res, cd4_lineage_ranks, up_newDC_vs_DC2_genes, "CD4 lineage, ascites", "survival", "up in DC: PIGR, RORC vs DC2")

# CD4 clusters 1 and 9, ascites, survival
plot_cd4_cluster <- function(clust) {
    cd4_cluster_fgsea_res <- read.csv("/projects/home/tlchan/external_cluster_deg_gsea.csv", row.names = 1) %>%
        filter(lineage == "cd4") %>%
        filter(tissue_type == "ascites") %>%
        filter(cluster == clust) %>%
        filter(var == "survival") %>%
        filter(pathway == "up_newDC_vs_DC2")

    cd4_cluster_stats <- read.csv("/projects/home/tlchan/projects/ascites/second_data_freeze/data/degs/cluster_level/cd4_survival/cd4_ascites_de_by_survival_all_results.csv") %>%
        filter(cluster == clust) %>%
        arrange(desc(log2FoldChange)) %>%
        select(gene_symbol, log2FoldChange)
    cd4_cluster_ranks <- setNames(cd4_cluster_stats$log2FoldChange, cd4_cluster_stats$gene_symbol)

    cd4_cluster_p <- plot_fgsea(cd4_cluster_fgsea_res, cd4_cluster_ranks, up_newDC_vs_DC2_genes, glue("CD4 C{clust}, ascites"), "survival", "up in DC: PIGR, RORC vs DC2")
}


pdf("/projects/home/tlchan/fig_panels/fig_5f.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)
print(cd4_lineage_p)
lapply(c(1, 9), plot_cd4_cluster)
dev.off()
```
